content.text:
Fixed. `to_cents` in `ledger/currency.py` was using `int(amount * 100)`, which truncates. In floating point, `19.99 * 100` is `1998.9999…`, so the result came out one cent low. It now converts through `Decimal(str(amount))` and rounds half up. The full suite passes (5 tests).

`str(amount)` means a float is read as its printed value, so `19.99` becomes exactly 19.99. Amounts with more than two decimal places are rounded to the nearest cent, with halves rounding up.
